```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

<!--
Figure 2: time spent at the reward port ("drinking" events, from each
session's drinking_data_iti_2.txt / drinking_data_incorrect_trials_iti_2.txt),
DOI vs. saline, split by correct (2A/2B) vs. incorrect (2C/2D) trials.
2A/2C = cumulative distribution of single-event duration, split further
into odor vs. omission trials; 2B/2D = per-mouse median duration, paired
scatter.
-->

```{r import data}
# mouse id, doi session number, and saline session number for each animal
mouse_sessions <- data.frame(
  mouse_id = c(2191, 2195, 2196, 2197, 2198, 2200, 2201, 2202, 2203, 2204, 2205, 2208, 2209, 2210, 2211, 2212, 2213),
  session_doi = c(25, 17, 18, 17, 17, 14, 16, 19, 13, 17, 12, 18, 14, 17, 13, 16, 14),
  session_saline = c(21, 20, 16, 19, 19, 19, 21, 14, 18, 22, 16, 14, 18, 13, 17, 13, 18)
)

# path to the root directory containing the raw session data
root_directory <- "D:/newmove"

# female mouse ids; all others are male
# 2174 f, 2181 f, 2182 m, 2183 m, 2185 m, 2191 f, 2195-98 m, 2200-2204 f,
# 2205-06 m, 2208-09 m, 2210-13 f
female_ids <- c(2174, 2181, 2191, 2200, 2201, 2202, 2203, 2204, 2210, 2211, 2212, 2213)

# reads one drinking-events file, dropping any malformed "error" lines,
# and returns a data frame with columns start_time/end_time/duration/odor.
# returns NULL if the file has no valid rows or fails to parse.
read_drinking_data <- function(file) {
  lines <- readLines(file)
  valid_lines <- lines[!grepl("Error", lines)]

  if (length(valid_lines) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  col_names <- c("start_time", "end_time", "duration", "odor")

  result <- tryCatch({
    read.table(textConnection(valid_lines), header = FALSE, sep = ",", col.names = col_names)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("error reading file with 4 columns: %s", e$message))
    NULL
  })

  if (!is.null(result) && nrow(result) > 0) {
    return(result)
  } else {
    message(sprintf("file %s returned null or has no valid rows.", file))
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# loads one drinking-events file per mouse/session (doi + saline) from
# root_directory/<mouse_id>/100-0/<session>/<file_name>, and returns a
# named list of data frames (name = "<mouse_id>_<session>")
load_drinking_data <- function(file_name, mouse_sessions, root_directory) {
  data_list <- list()
  file_names <- c()

  for (i in 1:nrow(mouse_sessions)) {
    mouse_id <- mouse_sessions$mouse_id[i]
    sessions <- c(mouse_sessions$session_doi[i], mouse_sessions$session_saline[i])

    for (session in sessions) {
      file_path <- file.path(root_directory, as.character(mouse_id), "100-0", as.character(session), file_name)

      if (file.exists(file_path)) {
        result <- tryCatch({
          read_drinking_data(file_path)
        }, error = function(e) {
          message(sprintf("error reading file %s: %s", file_path, e$message))
          NULL
        })

        if (!is.null(result) && nrow(result) > 0) {
          data_list <- c(data_list, list(result))
          file_names <- c(file_names, sprintf("%d_%d", mouse_id, session))
        } else {
          message(sprintf("file %s returned null or has no valid rows.", file_path))
        }
      } else {
        message(sprintf("file %s does not exist.", file_path))
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(data_list) > 0) {
    names(data_list) <- file_names
  }

  data_list
}

# combines a named list of per-session drinking-event data frames (as
# produced by load_drinking_data) into one data frame, tagging each row
# with condition (doi/saline, based on mouse_sessions), sex, and mouse id.
# sessions that don't match a doi or saline session for that mouse are
# dropped.
combine_drinking_data <- function(data_list, mouse_sessions, female_ids) {
  rows <- lapply(names(data_list), function(name) {
    name_parts <- unlist(strsplit(name, "_"))
    mouse_id <- as.numeric(name_parts[1])
    session <- as.numeric(name_parts[2])

    condition <- ifelse(
      session %in% mouse_sessions$session_doi[mouse_sessions$mouse_id == mouse_id], "DOI",
      ifelse(session %in% mouse_sessions$session_saline[mouse_sessions$mouse_id == mouse_id], "Saline", NA)
    )

    if (is.na(condition)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df <- data_list[[name]]
    df$condition <- condition
    df$sex <- ifelse(mouse_id %in% female_ids, "F", "M")
    df$mouse_id <- mouse_id
    df
  })

  dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
}
```

# Correct trials

```{r load correct trial data}
drinking_data_correct <- load_drinking_data("drinking_data_iti_2.txt", mouse_sessions, root_directory)
```

```{r combine correct trial data}
# combined_correct has one row per drinking event, with condition/sex/mouse_id
# attached; odor is 0 for odor trials and 3 for omission trials
combined_correct <- combine_drinking_data(drinking_data_correct, mouse_sessions, female_ids) %>%
  filter(!is.na(duration))
```

```{r wilcoxon correct pooled}
# pooled comparison of drinking duration: doi vs. saline, all odor/omission
# trials combined
doi_duration_correct <- combined_correct %>% filter(condition == "DOI") %>% pull(duration)
saline_duration_correct <- combined_correct %>% filter(condition == "Saline") %>% pull(duration)

wilcox_correct_pooled <- wilcox.test(doi_duration_correct, saline_duration_correct)
print("wilcoxon rank-sum test result (correct trials, pooled):")
print(wilcox_correct_pooled)
```

```{r fig 2a factor}
# condition_odor separates each condition into odor trials (0) and
# omission trials (3), for the cumulative frequency plot below
combined_correct$condition_odor <- interaction(combined_correct$condition, combined_correct$odor, sep = " - ")
combined_correct$condition_odor <- factor(combined_correct$condition_odor,
                                          levels = c("DOI - 0", "DOI - 3", "Saline - 0", "Saline - 3"))
```

```{r fig 2a stats}
# doi-odor vs. saline-odor and saline-omission
# kruskal-wallis + bonferroni-corrected pairwise wilcoxon post-hoc
# across the 4 condition_odor groups.
kruskal_correct <- kruskal.test(duration ~ condition_odor, data = combined_correct)
print("kruskal-wallis test result:")
print(kruskal_correct)

post_hoc_kruskal_correct <- pairwise.wilcox.test(combined_correct$duration,
                                                  combined_correct$condition_odor,
                                                  p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
print("post-hoc pairwise comparisons (wilcoxon, bonferroni-corrected):")
print(post_hoc_kruskal_correct)
```

```{r fig 2a sex effect supplemental}
# sex effect of condition: kruskal-wallis on duration across the 4-way
# condition x sex split. not significant, so no post-hoc is reported.
combined_correct$condition_sex <- interaction(combined_correct$condition, combined_correct$sex, sep = " - ")
combined_correct$condition_sex <- factor(combined_correct$condition_sex,
                                         levels = c("DOI - M", "DOI - F", "Saline - M", "Saline - F"))

kruskal_sex_correct <- kruskal.test(duration ~ condition_sex, data = combined_correct)
print("kruskal-wallis test result:")
print(kruskal_sex_correct)
```

# Figure 2A

```{r fig 2a}
combined_correct %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = duration,
             color = condition_odor)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step",
            linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("DOI - 0" = "#b876e3",
               "DOI - 3" = "#53e307",
               "Saline - 0" = "black",
               "Saline - 3" = "darkgray"),
    labels = c("DOI - Odor",
               "DOI - Omission",
               "Saline - Odor",
               "Saline - Omission"),
    name = "Condition"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 15)) +
  labs(title = "Reward port duration on correct trials",
       x = "Time in reward port (s)",
       y = "Cumulative frequency") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.15),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.2))
```

```{r fig 2a supplemental by sex}
combined_correct %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = duration,
             color = condition_sex)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step",
            linewidth = 1) +

    values = c("DOI - F" = "#b876e3",
               "DOI - M" = "#53e307",

    name = "Condition"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 15)) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.15),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.2))
```

```{r median duration correct}
# median drinking duration per mouse, split by condition
median_correct <- combined_correct %>%
  group_by(mouse_id, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    doi_duration = median(duration[condition == "DOI"], na.rm = TRUE),
    saline_duration = median(duration[condition == "Saline"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r wilcoxon correct paired}
wilcox_correct_paired <- wilcox.test(median_correct$doi_duration,
                                     median_correct$saline_duration,
                                     paired = TRUE)

print(wilcox_correct_paired)
```

```{r median duration correct by odor and omission}
# 2b supplemental: per-mouse median duration split by trial type
# (odor vs. omission), not just by condition
median_correct_by_odor <- combined_correct %>%
  group_by(mouse_id, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    doi_odor = median(duration[condition == "DOI" & odor == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    saline_odor = median(duration[condition == "Saline" & odor == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    doi_omission = median(duration[condition == "DOI" & odor == 3], na.rm = TRUE),
    saline_omission = median(duration[condition == "Saline" & odor == 3], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wilcox_correct_odor <- wilcox.test(median_correct_by_odor$doi_odor,
                                   median_correct_by_odor$saline_odor,
                                   paired = TRUE)
print("odor trials, doi vs. saline (2b supplemental):")
print(wilcox_correct_odor)

# omission trials: source drops incomplete pairs explicitly here (not every
# mouse has usable omission-trial drinking events in both conditions)
wilcox_correct_omission <- wilcox.test(median_correct_by_odor$doi_omission,
                                       median_correct_by_odor$saline_omission,
                                       paired = TRUE,
                                       na.action = na.omit)
print("omission trials, doi vs. saline (2b supplemental):")
print(wilcox_correct_omission)
```

```{r fig 2b supplemental odor plot}
group_stats_correct_odor <- median_correct_by_odor %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarize(
    doi_median = median(doi_odor, na.rm = TRUE),
    saline_median = median(saline_odor, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
median_correct_by_odor %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = saline_odor,
             y = doi_odor,
             color = sex,
             shape = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 6,
             stroke = 1.5,
             alpha = 0.8) +

  # add group medians
  geom_point(data = group_stats_correct_odor,
             aes(x = saline_median,
                 y = doi_median,
                 color = sex),
             size = 10,
             shape = 1,   # big o
             stroke = 2.5,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("M" = "#00B19E",
                                "F" = "#990068"),
                     guide = "none") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1,
              intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dotted",
              color = "black",
              size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Reward port duration \ncorrect odor trials",
       x = "Saline median (s)",
       y = "DOI median (s)",
       shape = "Sex") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.15),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.2)) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = c("#990068", "#00B19E"))))
```

```{r group stats correct}
group_stats_correct <- median_correct %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarize(
    doi_mean = mean(doi_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    doi_median = median(doi_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    saline_mean = mean(saline_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    saline_median = median(saline_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

# Incorrect trials

```{r load incorrect trial data}
drinking_data_incorrect <- load_drinking_data("drinking_data_incorrect_trials_iti_2.txt", mouse_sessions, root_directory)
```

```{r combine incorrect trial data}
combined_incorrect <- combine_drinking_data(drinking_data_incorrect, mouse_sessions, female_ids) %>%
  filter(!is.na(duration))
```

```{r wilcoxon incorrect pooled}
doi_duration_incorrect <- combined_incorrect %>% filter(condition == "DOI") %>% pull(duration)
saline_duration_incorrect <- combined_incorrect %>% filter(condition == "Saline") %>% pull(duration)

wilcox_incorrect_pooled <- wilcox.test(doi_duration_incorrect, saline_duration_incorrect)
print("wilcoxon rank-sum test result (incorrect trials, pooled):")
print(wilcox_incorrect_pooled)
```

```{r fig 2c factor and stats}
combined_incorrect$condition_odor <- interaction(combined_incorrect$condition, combined_incorrect$odor, sep = " - ")
combined_incorrect$condition_odor <- factor(combined_incorrect$condition_odor,
                                            levels = c("DOI - 0", "DOI - 3", "Saline - 0", "Saline - 3"))

kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(duration ~ condition_odor, data = combined_incorrect)
print("kruskal-wallis test result:")
print(kruskal_result)

post_hoc_kruskal <- pairwise.wilcox.test(combined_incorrect$duration,
                                          combined_incorrect$condition_odor,
                                          p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
print("post-hoc pairwise comparisons (wilcoxon, bonferroni-corrected):")
print(post_hoc_kruskal)
```

```{r fig 2c sex effect supplemental}
combined_incorrect$condition_sex <- interaction(combined_incorrect$condition, combined_incorrect$sex, sep = " - ")
combined_incorrect$condition_sex <- factor(combined_incorrect$condition_sex,
                                           levels = c("DOI - M", "DOI - F", "Saline - M", "Saline - F"))

kruskal_sex_incorrect <- kruskal.test(duration ~ condition_sex, data = combined_incorrect)

              size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Reward port duration \nincorrect omission trials",
       x = "Saline median (s)",
       y = "DOI median (s)",
       shape = "Sex") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.15),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.2)) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = c("#990068", "#00B19E"))))
```
